title: Asservat capacity values v1
description: The hub chart's `capacity` values (ADR-335 D2, D8; REQ-CAP-004). Every field is optional; defaults derive from the evidence store and the cluster. Changes apply on helm upgrade. Ring, frozen, spool, upload and ongoing-source limits are node collector values (ADR-246).

oneOf.description: Percentage of the usable evidence storage.

evidenceStorage.description: Usable evidence bytes after the backend full threshold and replication overhead. Default: the bundled object store's volume size; required for an external store.

storageAssurance.description: qualifiedReservedBackend requires dedicated or backend-enforced capacity; only it satisfies the isolation claim.

capturesPerCluster.description: Concurrent captures per cluster. Default max(8, node count).

namespaceLimit.description: Maximum stored bytes per namespace, so many small workloads cannot monopolize enrollment. Omitted: no namespace cap.

share.description: Protected allocation per workload. Default usable capacity ÷ max(eligible workloads, 8).

limit.description: Hard maximum per workload (protected share plus burst). Default 10%.
